name: Al Manara
positioning: Al Manara, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Saraya Aqaba: a Red Sea hotel with a private beach and lagoon, designed with inspiration from Jordanian heritage
best_for: Couples who want a villa with its own private pool by the Red Sea
Families who want interconnecting rooms or a two-bedroom suite
Travelers combining the Red Sea with Petra and Wadi Rum

facts.text: Al Manara, a Luxury Collection Hotel, sits along the historic shores of Aqaba, Jordan.
The hotel has a private beach in Aqaba.
The accommodations are designed with inspiration from Jordanian heritage and tradition.
Rooms have Luxury Collection signature beds and Frette linens.
Bathrooms are marble, with bathtubs and Byredo bath amenities.
Suites, villas and penthouses come with more living space and butler service.
For families, there are interconnecting rooms and villas.
The 2 Bedroom Family Suite sleeps up to six.
Heavenly Spa has a couple's room and saunas in both the women's and men's facilities.
The outdoor pool area includes a children's pool, with a lifeguard on duty.
Amwaj serves fresh seafood, live grills and cocktails with Red Sea views and live DJ sets.
Kubba Levantin serves Middle Eastern cuisine and fresh seafood with live entertainment and indoor and outdoor seating.

highlights.text: Each villa has a private pool.
Room terraces or balconies look out over the Red Sea and the hotel's private lagoon.
Heavenly Spa offers globally inspired treatments, Dead Sea rituals, couples massages and beauty services in a lagoon setting.
The concierge can guide guests through Jordan's Golden Triangle, from Petra to Wadi Rum.
Amwaj Art Hub, overlooking the Red Sea, shows paintings by Ghassan Abu Laban and sculptures by Hazem Al-Zubi.

considerations.text: Aqaba Airport (AQJ) is about 10 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the location is remote from Jordan's major cultural sites.
